3698-5034-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3698-5034-5660-6769.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Grinding Station and Surge Conductor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sol Ring, causing a player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2131-2173-2921-4574--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2131-2173-2921-4574--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

883-1339-1832-5231.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
883-1339-1832-5231.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-6026--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-6026--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7160-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5147-6255.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Zahur, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7829-7834.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7829-7834.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Naga Fleshcrafter and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

813-1987-2020.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
813-1987-2020.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
813-1987-2020.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4423-5733-6886-7705.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
4423-5733-6886-7705.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
4423-5733-6886-7705.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

586-2921-4871-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1169-2440-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1169-2440-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

4186-4384-7173.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4384-7173.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

539-2244-4460-4803.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4460-4803.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

2464-3459-5078-5741.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3459-5078-5741.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1003-3698-4053-6989.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Phyrexian Walker enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

681-5226-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5226-6621-6763.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-1322-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

856-2921-4321-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2921-4321-6351.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

4973-5657-6489.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
4973-5657-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
4973-5657-6489.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

411-4103-4419-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-4103-4419-4613.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

765-774-2653.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

803-2438-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-2438-5853.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
803-2438-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

5184-5435-5742-5743.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1621-2719.description:
Cast Sakashima of a Thousand Faces either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

409-957-4211.description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Time Stretch to your hand from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

1335-2216-2440.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2216-2440.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Unbound Flourishing's second ability triggers, copying Marath's ability.
Resolve both Marath abilities, creating two 1/1 Elemental creture tokens.
The Elementals enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice, adding {C}{C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
 Unbound Flourishing's second ability triggers, copying Marath's ability.
Resolve both Marath abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may repeat steps 5-7 to give Marath infinite +1/+1 counters, then use them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1355-1995.notablePrerequisites:
Gauntlets of Light attached to Sanctum Weaver.
You control at least two other enchantments.
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
1355-1995.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Sanctum Weaver by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1769-2201-3025-4187.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2396-4869.notablePrerequisites:
Ophidian Eye attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size.
2396-4869.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
After all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.
